description:
Madobe is a web browser. An address bar and a WebKit view, the same engine Safari uses.

Type an address to open it. Type anything else and it searches DuckDuckGo. Back, forward, reload, and tabs. Nothing else until there is a reason.

• Address bar with search fallback
• Back, forward, reload
• Tabs
• No account, no tracking, no ads
• Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac

Madobe collects nothing. Sites you open are the only ones that see you.
promotionalText: An address bar and a WebKit view. Nothing else until there is a reason.
